snippet.title: THe Float Never Stops : REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
The heist went sideways. The tuna went everywhere. The float? It never stops. 🐟
👉 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5090250/The_Float_Never_Stops

🐱 Hijack a parade float full of tuna… then drop it all
🏗️ Stack the tuna back on with whatever junk you find in the street
🚔 Keep moving: the float NEVER stops
😼 Everyone has a secret goal. Nobody's a traitor, but everyone's selfish
👥 1–4 players: online, local or Remote Play Together

Coming to Steam in 2027.
